text:
Priya Nair: Quick idea 9 tiny refapp mini-challenges to drive community onboarding + measurable repo signals. Each challenge = 10-15min tutorial + 1 bench chart + 1 CTA to open an issue/demo request. Launch cadence: 1/week for 3 weeks.

Theo Park: sounds good. what's the narrative?

Priya Nair: narrative = "start small, ship faster". Week1: build a low-latency chat widget. Week2: embed search with embeddings. Week3: cost-savvy quant inference. Each post includes a reproducible benchmark and a VS table (hosted vs dedicated vs quant).

Maya Patel: love the three-prong approach. KPIs: repo stars (+20% week-over-week), demo signups (tracked via GH issue form), webinar registrants (optional end-of-series). Need clear owners and assets.

Samir Rao: I can own the bench runs. Proposal: run 3 configs per challenge, output CSVs and a single summary png. Will include a short reproducibility README. ETA for run artifacts: Tue noon each week.

Jamie (DevRel): I'll write the tutorial text and short GIFs. Also will create a lightweight challenge badge for GitHub READMEs and a 'Completed Challenge' issue template.

Priya Nair: owners: Week1 Theo (demo) + Samir (bench) + Jamie (copy/gif). Week2 Maya (demo) + Samir + Jamie. Week3 Theo + Samir + Jamie. Marketing will assemble the blog post + social.

Theo Park: technical constraints: keep demos under 5 files, include run.sh and a Dockerfile optional. For benchmarks, prefer a script like:

```
# benchmark.sh
python run_bench.py --model rwd/mini-ggml --batch 1 --seq 128 --json-out out.json
python summarize.py out.json > summary.csv
```

Priya Nair: nice. For inbound routing: GH issue label = "challenge-demo", GH issue form fields: name, org, email, use-case, enterprise? (checkbox). The form should auto-post to #community-demos and create a HubSpot lead with tag "mini-challenge". If enterprise domain present, ping sales-ops.

Maya Patel: can marketing-bot handle the HubSpot push? @marketing-bot any ETA?

marketing-bot: integration status: HubSpot webhook ready. Need final issue-form schema file in repo to enable.

Jamie (DevRel): I'll draft the issue form JSON and add the label + template. Also recommend a simple routing microflow: GH issue -> Zapier webhook -> HubSpot (tag) + Slack notify (#community-demos).

Samir Rao: small ask  can we include the raw CSVs as blog assets and a downloadable notebook? helps reproducibility and press.

Priya Nair: yes. marketing will host assets under /assets/mini-challenges/ and add UTMs: utm_source=oss_challenge&utm_campaign=mini_challenges_q2.

Theo Park: licensing note: demos should be MIT and include a short "production caution" blurb re: privacy and key handling.

Maya Patel: timeline:
- Mon (this week): finalize owners + templates
- Wed: first draft of week1 tutorial + bench scripts
- Fri: publish week1 post + assets + social
- following Mon: promote + collect feedback

Priya Nair: tracking: create a simple Notion board with columns: backlog, in-progress, review, published. Link it in the repo README. KPI tracker sheet will record stars, issues created, demo requests, webinar regs.

repo-bot: Branch created: refs/mini-challenges/week1 by Theo Park. Files: run.sh, README.md, benchmark.sh.

Jamie (DevRel): social hooks: short thread + 30s gif, TL;DR "Build a latency-first chat in 10 minutes". Use hashtag #RedwoodRefapps. Schedule posts around 10am PT on publish day.

Priya Nair: ask finance for $100 credits for hosted bench runs across three weeks. @Samir will you estimate usage?

Samir Rao: estimate ~2 hours GPU across runs total. $100 should cover it.

Theo Park: I pushed an initial demo and added a quick start section. Need permissions: @Jamie please check GIF recording notes.

Jamie (DevRel): will do. Also adding a short reproducibility section with commands and expected outputs.

Maya Patel: blockers?

Jamie (DevRel): minor  need a final hero image. Can design help? @design-team?

Priya Nair: pinged design offline.

Maya Patel: perfect. I'll synth this into a Notion checklist and post the launch calendar. Thanks team :tada:

repo-bot: Reminder: review requested by Priya Nair at 1972003500
